correctness.rationale: The displayed formulas are integer linear comparisons and use #top, not an n-dependent constant or a modulo connective. At a depth-one test the independent letter counts are binomial. The probability that a specified pair is the unique tied maximum is the sum of the squared binomial mass times the (m−2)nd power of the strict lower cdf. On z=(2t−n)/√n the lattice spacing is 2/√n, giving 2I_m/√n from the local CLT and Riemann sum. Uniform maximum binomial mass O(n^(-1/2)) controls the tails of the rescaled squared mass by the binomial tail, and bounds the probability of any specified triple tie by O(n^(-1)). This gives the claimed delta_m. The #B_m count is binomial by subtree independence. Its integer target exists exactly on the chosen residue class (for n≥r); there it differs from the mean by delta_m√n+o(√n). Stirling's formula with u_m(n) bounded away from 0 and 1 gives the displayed local mass and alpha_m. The n independent tests amplify it, with n times the squared local mass bounded. The disjoint unique-winner events in the fresh-letter gate have total probability a u_b(n); the endpoint gates are constants. Freshness makes detector and gate independent even without disjoint vertex sets. Exactly one residue can contribute, giving each rational limit at depth at most three. The finite checker was read but not executed; no portion of the limiting proof rests on it.
residual_risks: All moduli and all gates are fixed before the limit. The stretched-exponential rate is for detector failure on its own residue, not for convergence of an arbitrary rational output gate.

The frozen construction obtains a Bernoulli parameter with center 1/m and a controlled O(n^(-1/2)) tie deficit, then tests a target integer that is available only in one residue class.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Once the local mass is known, amplification is standard and already present in these sources. It is not a substitute for all-moduli selection: the unique-plurality construction and its tie correction provide a new ingredient for the exact target mass and constant. The indexed dates do not establish priority.

originality.rationale: The surviving claim is the uniform construction for each prescribed finite modulus and rational profile in ordinary probabilities, with the explicit detector constant for every modulus. It is not the invention of parity oscillation, rare-event amplification, or exact parity pairs in isolation.
residual_risks: The bounded primary-literature search is not evidence of historical priority. Parity and the amplification mechanism are covered in inspected work; the pass is for the general modulus theorem and its quantitative construction.

value.rationale: The result shows that the failure of an ordinary limiting probability is not restricted to a parity pathology: even without congruence syntax, three fixed counting layers realize arbitrary finite residue profiles. The explicit detector failure rate explains why the arithmetic support survives with probability tending to one. This is a structural expressivity result, beyond producing additional individual oscillation examples.
residual_risks: No depth-three optimality, full classification of possible limit behaviors, or irrational realization is established.
